text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Boo just realized!! —Bouquet is also a 
"Boo"!!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Right, right?! We're the Oink-Oink Duo♪

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I know! I want Bouquet to say "Boo" too! 
Saying "Boo-boo" sounds like so much fun♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—...Then—shall we talk like that... for 
just a little while? —B-"Boo"... and all.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah!! So cute! Let's do it, let's chat 
it up!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Boo! Boo wants to find some flowers 
to decorate the room with!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Oooh~! Ooooh~~! Nice, that's awesome! 
Matching is great too♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... You are right— I feel as though I, 
too, have become dazzling and bright— just 
like Blast-san.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, thanks! Then this time—it's my turn 
to be gentle and fluffy just like a 
bouquet!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Thank you. It really is... so 
fluffy.
